task: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to venture west. And then, try to go to the south. Then, go west. And then, pick up the passkey from the floor of the dish-pit. And once you've done that, you win!
description:
You find yourself in a bedchamber. A typical one.



There is a closed portal leading south. There is an open door leading east. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unblocked. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unblocked.

thought: I should go west as the task instructs.
feedback:
Well, here we are in a cellar.

You see a display. Something scurries by right in the corner of your eye. Probably nothing. You bend down to tie your shoe. When you stand up, you notice a safe. You can make out a locked cabinet right there by you. If you haven't noticed it already, there seems to be something there by the wall, it's a table. But there isn't a thing on it. Hopefully, this discovery doesn't ruin your TextWorld experience!

You need an unguarded exit? You should try going east. There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unblocked.

There is a latchkey on the floor.
